description: Verbatim rerun of exp732 (fp32 LUT storage + bf16 compute + standard Lion, no grad clip, no unembedder autocast). Same seed (42). Tests reproducibility of exp732's 1.3912 baseline. If exp746 matches within ~0.5 mb, the recipe is stable and the 4 mb advantage of exp737 v2 (1.3872, bf16 storage + fp32 master Lion) is real. If it differs more, we have a noise floor to factor into all comparisons.
